title: Mining topic and sentiment dynamics in physician rating websites during the early wave of the COVID-19 pandemic: Machine learning approach.
summary: TCLDA topic modeling, manual annotation and sentiment analysis of 55,612 reviews from three US physician-rating sites identified topic and emotion trends during March–June 2020. This is a specific empirical public-health/social-science result; review-site users are not representative of all patients and the short window cannot establish pandemic-caused changes. Organization is unavailable in the deposited bibliographic metadata.
